collection: Immutable Git objects; working files and untracked files are not counted.

ci.note: Workflow runs attached to this Git revision. Jobs are not test cases; reusable workflows may validate another requested ref. No line coverage is inferred.

label: Default branch

policy.dependencies: Unique registry/Git dependency names declared in first-party Cargo manifests outside fixture folders, including optional/dev/build/target entries. Path dependencies are separate authored packages; this is not the enabled build graph.
policy.lines: Physical lines, including comments and blank lines; not semantic LOC.
policy.lockfile: Root Cargo.lock packages with a source, across its recorded resolution; not a particular feature selection.
policy.tests: Rust files in tests directories or with test/test(s) filename segments; not executed tests.
